blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is called Simple Invoices. It gives you short, useful sentences for the finance team.

An invoice is a bill. It has a client, a total, a date, and each item on it. Every invoice has to match the records. The numbers must be clear and honest.

Sophie helps new trainees. She uses short sentences and simple words. "Go slowly," she says. "One careful step at a time. You can do it!"

items.q: What is the lesson called?
items.why: "Today's lesson is called Simple Invoices."

items.q: What does an invoice have?
options: A client, a total, a date, and items
items.why: "It has a client, a total, a date, and each item on it."

items.q: Who helps the new trainees?
items.why: "Sophie helps new trainees."

items.q: The text says numbers must be "clear and honest." This suggests that…
options: invoices are only for the boss
the total can be a guess
mistakes on an invoice are not important
items.why: Inferência: se os números têm que ser claros e honestos, a exatidão é essencial.

items.q: "One careful step at a time" suggests that Sophie…
items.why: Inferência: ir devagar, um passo de cada vez, mostra paciência com quem está começando.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com o novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the accounting team. I'm Sophie. Don't worry — we start with easy things.

This is an invoice. Look here. It has a client at the top. It has a total at the bottom. And it has a date, right here. Every line is one item. Simple, yes?

Our team is small, but we are very organised. Every invoice has to match our records. So we check the date at the end of every day. One careful step at a time.

There is a new client to review this week. I have the file on my desk. When the total is ready for a signature, please leave the item on my desk. I will check it with you.

You can do it. Go slowly. Ask me any question. One step at a time — that's how good accountants work!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is the total on the invoice?
items.why: "It has a total at the bottom."

items.q: When does the team check the date?
options: At the end of every day
items.why: "we check the date at the end of every day."

items.q: What should the trainee do when the total is ready?
options: Leave the item on Sophie's desk
items.why: "please leave the item on my desk."

items.q: Sophie says the team is small "but very organised." This suggests that…
options: size is more important than order
a small team can still work carefully
items.why: Inferência: pequeno, mas organizado — o cuidado não depende do tamanho da equipe.

items.q: How does Sophie make the trainee feel?
items.why: Inferência: "don't worry", "go slowly", "you can do it" — ela acolhe e tranquiliza.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please send the invoice to the client today." An invoice is…
items.why: Invoice = fatura, a conta que se envia ao cliente.

items.q: "We have a new client this week." A client is…
options: a person or company that buys from us
items.why: Client = cliente, quem compra o serviço ou produto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ at the bottom of the invoice is $500."
items.why: Total = o valor final somado, que fica no fim da fatura.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "What is the ___ on this invoice? Is it today?"
items.why: Date = data; a pergunta é sobre o dia.

items.q: "Every line on the invoice is one item." An item is…
items.why: Item = item, cada coisa listada na fatura.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you fill in the date on the invoice?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever no espaço.

items.q: "Please check over the total before you send it." To check over means to…
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com atenção.

items.q: "The boss will sign off on the invoice today." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "I need to go over the numbers with you." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = repassar, revisar juntos.

items.q: "Don't worry, I will help you out." To help someone out means to…
items.why: Help out = ajudar, dar apoio a alguém.
